_doc: The sounds the game plays (openspec/changes/sound-effects, design section 3): per cue its file (a committed OGG under assets/audio, built by tools/audio/render_sfx.sh), the bus it plays on (Master, Music or Effects, set by the Options sheet's boxes: src/Game/Ui/AudioSettings.cs) and its level in dB at that bus. The console keys first (owner, 2026-11-07: "Console keys - this should be implemented in the game"): each skin names its key cue in its style (src/Game/Ui/Kit/*Kit.cs, SkinStyle.KeySound); and the bridge bed under a battle (owner, 2026-11-07: "use amb_bridge_brown", "put in game now"; src/Game/Ui/ConsoleSounds.cs).
